comment: The reset input and the reset button carry no configInput or configParam name, so hovering either shows nothing; the panel prints 'reset' beside them. Bufke pushes the raw voltage into its buffer (Bufke.cpp:173) where Ad scales by a tenth first, so the output carries the same voltages that went in. With no parent the module falls back to sixteen channels and partial numbers 1 to 16 (lines 111-114). The buffer is four seconds long, matching Adje rather than Ad's eight.
